Cybork Body: Each model has a 5+ ward save.
Dok's Speriments: After deployment and before the start of the first battle round, roll on the table below for each Cybork Slasha unit in the army:

Turbo Killas: The unit gains the Haste (1") and Frenzy (1") abilities. Whenever the unit activates with an Advance or Charge order, roll a D6 for each model in the unit. For each dice result of 1, the unit suffers a single wound; saves may be taken as normal and any unsaved wounds do not count towards Combat Results and cannot trigger a Leadership test if they cause the unit to drop below half strength.
Tinboy Brutes: All models in the unit gain +1 Toughness and the Unyielding ability.

Short Circuit: The Ork player may choose either Turbo Killas or Tinboy Brutes and apply it to the unit. Whenever the unit activates, roll a D6. On a result of 2-6, the unit activates normally. On a result of 1, the unit's order is immediately changed to "Fight", even if it is not in combat.

Narthecium: Once per battle round, the damage of a wound against the unit can be reduced by 1. The ability must be declared after armor and ward saves. Does not work against weapons with a strength of 8 or above.
